objective: Evaluate the supplied visual at its intended delivery size and produce evidence-grounded, purpose-scoped revision actions while preserving scientific meaning and unaffected content.
supplied_context: The subject is a public example. The rendered asset is the exact delivery candidate. Reference and source assets, when present, are context rather than replacement content.

visual_review.target_medium: final rendered page or screen at its intended reading size

criteria.requirement: The visual hierarchy and composition support the stated communication purpose and audience.
Text, symbols, marks, labels, legends, and important detail remain legible at delivery size.
Comparable elements align; spacing, gutters, dimensions, aspect ratios, and visual balance are consistent.
The presentation preserves the supplied meaning, data, labels, scale bars, and relationships without visually implying unsupported conclusions.
Typography, color, contrast, density, and style form a coherent visual system appropriate to the medium.

perspectives.focus: Information hierarchy, legibility, accessibility, and semantic fidelity.
Grid, alignment, spacing, proportion, balance, typography, and aesthetic coherence.
